title: Kickoff, ball out, throw-in
description: A scripted 16-second sequence: pre-match footage, kickoff, a home build-up down the right, a cross that goes out for a throw-in, the away restart, a brief home touch, and footage after the graded interval.

provenance.statement: Synthetic data, scripted in tools/export_scenarios.py. No competition data was read. Model labels are the unchanged Python engines' output.

events.description: Graded interval starts (frames before it are ungraded).
Kick Off (Start) set-piece tag, Team: Synthetic Home.
The whole ball crosses the touchline after a home cross.
Throw-in set-piece tag, Team: N/A (as for every throw-in).
A loose away pass reaches home #8, who keeps the ball for 8 frames before away #6 wins it back; by the script, away keeps possession.
Graded interval ends (frames after it are ungraded).

reference.description: Written down from the scenario script, not produced by any model.
